findings.detail:
The whole panel is behind `{readyUpload && (...)}`, so the `

` enters the DOM with its text already in it. Screen readers monitor live regions for *mutations* to a region that was already present; a region inserted pre-populated is announced inconsistently (NVDA and VoiceOver commonly stay silent). The commit message for 050693d states the result is announced — on this markup it often will not be. Impact is limited because the same summary is also pushed to the activity log via `addLog`, which is why this is low rather than high; it would rise to medium if the log panel were not itself announced.
findings.summary: `role="status"` region is mounted already populated, so it may not announce

findings.detail: `suggestByAliases` is newly exported, but the only caller anywhere in the repo is `suggestColumn` three lines above it in the same file — `readyToUpload.ts` imports `matchColumn`, not this. Its doc comment states "Used by Ready to upload for its extra fields", which is false and will send the next reader looking for a call site that does not exist. Per the code-smells handbook an unused export added in a PR is dead code; the misleading comment is the part that actually costs time later.
findings.summary: `suggestByAliases` is a new unused export whose docstring is wrong

findings.detail: `const col = (h: string) => COMPOSITE_UPLOAD_HEADERS.indexOf(...)` is called once per field (4) and twice per ingredient slot (60) inside the `sources.map` body, so each composite row costs ~64 linear scans over the 73-element header array — roughly 2,500 string comparisons per row, all recomputing a constant. This is O(n·k) with a fixed k, not quadratic, so it will not freeze the tab; it is simply a free constant to give back, and the same shape repeats in `readySummary` only once (correctly hoisted there).
findings.summary: `col()` does a 73-entry linear `indexOf` ~64 times per composite row
